title: The Hidden Reason Your Teeth Whisper at Night

scenes.text: Your molars make tiny noises while you sleep in the dark!
Bruxism—unconscious grinding—creates vibrations that travel through the jawbone.
scenes.label: BRUXISM VIBRATIONS

scenes.text: Saliva’s surface tension amplifies the sound, making it audible to sensitive microphones.
scenes.label: SALIVA AMPLIFIES

scenes.text: Stress hormones increase muscle tension, intensifying the grinding during REM cycles.
scenes.label: STRESS‑DRIVEN GRIND

scenes.text: Follow for facts that sound fake but aren't.
